texts.DataMigration:GuideIntro: Moves the old system's data into BlueDental, imported once. Sheet 1 "Khách hàng": one patient record per row. Sheet 2 "Điều trị": one treatment visit (one stage) per row, linked to the patient by Mã KH. Sheet 3 "Thanh toán" (optional): one payment the patient made per row. Sheet 4 "Lịch hẹn" (optional): one booking per row, past and upcoming. Services, doctors, sources, tags, disease history and receiving accounts must be written exactly as BlueDental names them (the branch's Catalogs and Staff screens) — a dry run points out every misspelled row. Giới tính, the guardian's relation, Trạng thái and Hình thức carry a drop-down list (the arrow at the cell's corner). Any error blocks the whole file — download the error file and read its "Lỗi" column. A Mã KH the branch already holds is skipped with its treatment, payment and booking rows, so running the same file again creates nothing twice — which is why a patient's payments and bookings must be in the same file as the patient.

texts.DataMigration:GuideGrouping: How slips are grouped: rows with the same Mã KH and the same "Kế hoạch" form one treatment plan named after it (e.g. write "Chỉnh nha" on every orthodontic visit of a patient). With Kế hoạch blank, rows group by Mã phiếu; with that blank too, by day. Inside a plan, a row with Đơn giá opens a new service at that price (a Thành tiền below Số lượng × Đơn giá makes the difference a discount); a row without Đơn giá is one more visit on the latest service of the same name in the plan, or a service priced 0 when there is none. Leave every money column blank and services are priced 0 with no debt. Payments: the amount is spread over the services of the Mã phiếu (or Kế hoạch) on the row, each up to what it still owes; money left over is an error. Old slips with only a note and no service: use the placeholder service and doctor the clinic created (e.g. "Khám (hệ thống cũ)"), Kế hoạch = "Lịch sử cũ".
